title: Authorization Duration Terms of the Utilization Management Program
content:
Every approval under the Utilization Management Program runs for a set number of months from its effective date. The months depend on the kind of approval and on the member's review package.

## Months in force

| Review package | New prior authorization (default) | First-time approval months that differ for named drugs | Renewal approval | Step therapy approval (manual or automated) | Quantity limit exception approval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | 12 | Wegovy 6, Zepbound 6 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | 12 | Wegovy 6, Zepbound 6 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | 12 | Wegovy 6, Zepbound 6, Dupixent 6 | 12 | 12 | 6 |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | 12 | Wegovy 6, Zepbound 6, Dupixent 6 | 12 | 12 | 6 |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | 12 | Wegovy 6, Zepbound 6, Dupixent 6, Ibrance 6 | 12 | 24 | 6 |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | 12 | Wegovy 6, Zepbound 6, Dupixent 6, Ibrance 6 | 12 | 24 | 6 |

The named-drug months apply to a first-time approval only; a renewal of the same drug runs the renewal approval months.

## Effective date, strengths and concurrent approvals

| Review package | Calendar days before the decision date an effective date may be set back to cover a fill the member already paid for | Approval carries over to other strengths of the same drug | Approvals of the same type in force at once for one drug | Effective date of a renewal approved before the current approval expires |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | 0 (no retroactive approvals) | No | 1 | the day after the current expiration date |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | 0 (no retroactive approvals) | No | 1 | the day after the current expiration date |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | 14 | Yes | 1 | the day after the current expiration date |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | 14 | Yes | 1 | the day after the current expiration date |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | 30 | Yes | 1 | the day after the current expiration date |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | 30 | Yes | 1 | the day after the current expiration date |

### Questions the schedule answers

**For how long is a first Dupixent approval granted on Northbridge Clinical Standard?** Dupixent has no named-drug months on that package, so the default 12 months applies; on Northbridge Clinical Advanced and above a first Dupixent approval runs 6 months.

**Does an Ibrance renewal on Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive run 6 months?** No. The 6 months apply to the first-time approval; the renewal runs the 12 renewal months.

**Can the effective date of an approval on Northbridge Clinical Standard be set back to the date of a fill the member paid for?** No; that package allows 0 days.
